Sets the (new) value of the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header.

Changes to the WebSocketHttpHeaders created by this constructor will write through to the supplied HttpHeaders. If you wish to copy an existing HttpHeaders or WebSocketHttpHeaders instance, use HttpHeaders.copyOf(HttpHeaders) instead. Note, however, that copyOf() does not create an instance of WebSocketHttpHeaders.
items.translation: 此构造函数创建的 `WebSocketHttpHeaders` 的更改将写入提供的 `HttpHeaders`。如果您希望复制现有的 `HttpHeaders` 或 `WebSocketHttpHeaders` 实例，请使用 HttpHeaders.copyOf(HttpHeaders)。但请注意，`copyOf()` 不会创建 `WebSocketHttpHeaders` 的实例。

items.source: If the supplied HttpHeaders instance is a read-only HttpHeaders wrapper, it will be unwrapped to ensure that the WebSocketHttpHeaders instance created by this constructor is mutable. Once the writable instance is mutated, the read-only instance is likely to be out of sync and should be discarded.
items.translation: 如果提供的 HttpHeaders 实例是只读的HttpHeaders包装器，它将被解包以确保由此构造函数创建的WebSocketHttpHeaders 实例是可变的。一旦可写实例被修改，只读实例很可能不同步，应予以丢弃。
